name: Formidable Forms
couldBuild: A form builder, entry storage, email notifications and conditional logic. The forms you personally need are an evening.
stillMissing: Formidable's pitch is the layer above forms — calculations, entry views rendered as front-end tables and directories, and the integration list. Views in particular are closer to a small application builder than a form plugin, which is what separates it from the other three form products in this index.
requirements: Calculations across fields, including running totals
Front-end views that render entries as tables or directories
Integrations with your mailing list and payment provider
